user.title: Connect to Hermes Agent
user.description: Enter the address of the Hermes Agent API server and its API key. A first conversation agent is created with the default options.

data_description.url: Base URL of the Hermes API server, without a trailing /v1.
data_description.api_key: The value of API_SERVER_KEY on the Hermes server.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Hermes Agent
reconfigure.description: Change the address of the Hermes API server or its API key.

data_description.url: Base URL of the Hermes API server.
data_description.api_key: Leave empty to keep the current key.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Hermes Agent
reauth_confirm.description: Hermes at {url} rejected the API key. Enter the current key.

data_description.api_key: The value of API_SERVER_KEY on the Hermes server.

error.invalid_url: The URL must start with http:// or https:// and include a host name.

abort.already_configured: This Hermes server is already configured.

user.title: Add a conversation agent
user.description: Each agent is one conversation entity with its own prompt and Hermes session. Select it in an Assist pipeline.

data.name: Name
data.list_exposed_entities: List exposed entities in the prompt

data_description.name: Name of the conversation entity and its device.
data_description.prompt: System prompt sent with every voice request. It is rendered as a Home Assistant template, so template functions such as states() work. Device, area and language context is added after it.
data_description.model: Model sent to Hermes. The list comes from the server; you can also type a name. Leave empty to use the Hermes default.
data_description.session_key: Sent as X-Hermes-Session-Key to select the Hermes memory scope. Leave empty to send no key.
data_description.session_mode: How long a Hermes session continues across requests.
data_description.session_idle_timeout: In idle mode, start a new session after this many seconds without a request.
data_description.handoff_after: Seconds to wait for the answer before the satellite says it is working on it. 0 disables the hand-off.
data_description.speak_progress: When Hermes starts its first tool, the satellite says the progress message right away. The hand-off time then counts from the progress message. Needs a text to speech engine that supports streaming.
data_description.timeout: Maximum time for one request, including a handed-off request.
data_description.list_exposed_entities: Adds the entities exposed to Assist (ID, name, aliases, area) to the system prompt, so the agent can act on them without looking them up first. No states are sent.
data_description.reasoning_effort: How much the model thinks before it answers. Leave empty to use the Hermes default.

messages.name: Spoken messages
messages.description: Fixed sentences the satellite says. Write them in the language of the pipeline that uses this agent. Leave a field empty to use the English default.

data_description.handoff_message: Said when the answer is not ready within the hand-off time.
data_description.progress_message: Said when Hermes starts its first tool, if Say a progress message is on.
data_description.error_message: Said when a request fails: Hermes cannot be reached, rejects the API key, returns an error or no answer, or takes longer than the timeout. The cause is written to the log.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the conversation agent
reconfigure.description: Changing the session key or the session mode clears the stored Hermes session of this agent.

ask.name: Ask
ask.description: Sends text to Hermes with the prompt of the agent and returns the whole answer. Does not stream and does not hand off.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: Hermes session to use for this call only. The stored session is left unchanged.

agent_id.name: Agent
agent_id.description: The Hermes conversation agent to ask. Required only when more than one agent exists.

camera_entity_id.name: Camera
camera_entity_id.description: Sends a snapshot of this camera with the text, so Hermes can describe what it sees.

system_prompt.name: System prompt
system_prompt.description: Replaces the prompt of the agent for this call. It is sent as written, not rendered as a template. The exposed entities of the agent are still added.
